objective: Certificar readiness integral backend/SQL/repositorio de Cavas antes del canario E2E: Dashboard, Socios, Persona-Link, Botellas, Inventario, Consumos, Kardex, reportes, permisos, multiunidad, errores y flujo operativo. Sin frontend_build en este contrato; no mutar datos ni codigo ni Produccion.

queries.name: gate13a_r2_candidate
queries.sql: SELECT CONVERT(varchar(36),SocioID) AS SocioID,CONVERT(varchar(36),EmpresaID) AS UnidadNegocioID,NumeroSocio,Estatus,Activo,PersonaID,ClienteCRMID FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Socios WHERE SocioID=CONVERT(uniqueidentifier,N'62CA4D8A-F4B7-4C66-BE8C-2C13C7445A58') AND EmpresaID=CONVERT(uniqueidentifier,N'19E076FB-C6DE-4EA5-84AB-1CAA9E86082C');

queries.name: gate13a_r2_counts
queries.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Socios) AS socios,(SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Botellas) AS botellas,(SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Consumos) AS consumos,(SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM dbo.Gobierno_Persona) AS personas,(SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM dbo.Gobierno_PersonaVinculo) AS persona_vinculos;

queries.name: gate13a_r2_rbac
queries.sql: SELECT urc.UsuarioID,urc.RolID,CONVERT(varchar(36),urc.UnidadNegocioID) AS UnidadNegocioID,urc.EmpresaID,urc.Activo FROM dbo.Usuario_RolesContexto urc WHERE urc.UsuarioID=4 AND urc.Activo=1;

queries.name: gate13a_r2_fk
queries.sql: SELECT name,is_disabled,is_not_trusted FROM sys.foreign_keys WHERE parent_object_id IN (OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Socios'),OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Botellas'),OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Consumos')) ORDER BY name;

constraints: No RBAC permission user role menu company or unit changes
EDARSAHUB SQL Server remains source of truth
Gate13B remains blocked until both Gate13A components pass
